outcome: postpartum hemorrhage (blood loss >= 1000 mL within 24 hours)
cohort: The study included twin pregnancies delivered by cesarean section with live births at Mianyang Central Hospital from March 6, 2020 to March 6, 2025.
finding: This study successfully identified six independent risk factors for postpartum hemorrhage or the need for hemostatic intervention in twin cesarean deliveries and established a preliminary clinical nomogram prediction model.
mod_finding: Prolonged operative time and general anesthesia were identified as independent risk factors for postpartum hemorrhage or hemostatic intervention in twin cesarean deliveries.
